entities.summary: Masayu Anastasia is an Indonesian model and actress. She starred in "Juleha Anak Betawi Asli", Gengsi Gede-gedean, Haruskah Ku Mati, Laila, Karunia-Mu, Setetes Embun, Doiku Beken, Cinta Merah Jambu and the movie Buruan Cium Gue and Selamanya. She was also cast as a model in music videos for Peterpan and Ressa Herlambang.
